overall: The AG found the Select Board violated the Open Meeting Law by creating insufficiently detailed August 15 executive session minutes lacking a discussion summary and a document list, and ordered amendment.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the August 15 executive session minutes were insufficient because they did not say who the police complaint was against or its nature.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not dictate the content of a discussion at a meeting; rather, it requires that meeting minutes accurately summarize what was actually discussed.

allegations.summary: Minutes said the Board discussed the complaint without summarizing the substance of that discussion, which the AG found insufficient.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law requires that meeting minutes include more than a statement that a public body held a discussion about a specified topic; the Law requires that the minutes summarize the substance of the public body’s discussion.

allegations.summary: Board argued that G.L. c. 41, § 97D justified limiting the minutes' discussion summary to protect confidential information.
allegations.key_passage: The Board may not, however, choose to create insufficient meeting minutes as a means to protect information that it believes might be exempt from disclosure.

allegations.summary: Minutes did not include a list of documents used at the executive session; Board conceded this but said documents were referenced in the body.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law specifically requires that meeting minutes include a list of all documents and exhibits used by the public body during the meeting.

allegations.summary: AG noted concern, not raised in the complaint, that executive session discussed a topic not among the stated reasons for convening.
allegations.key_passage: Finally, although not raised in the complaint, we note our concern with the Board’s discussion in executive session of a topic—Ms. Mann’s contact with municipal staff and whether to pursue a no trespass order—that was not one of the stated reasons for which the executive session was convened.

allegations.summary: Complainant raised additional allegations about other sets of minutes that were not in the original complaint filed with the Board.
allegations.key_passage: As we have explained to Ms. Mann, we decline to review allegations that were not raised in an original Open Meeting Law complaint filed with the Board.

remedy: Within 30 days, amend the August 15 executive session minutes to accurately summarize the discussion of the Police Complaint.
Within 30 days, amend the August 15 executive session minutes to include a list of the documents used at the meeting.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board, within 30 days of the date of this letter, to amend the minutes of its August 15 executive session to accurately summarize its discussion of the Police Complaint.
